instruction: Enable sticky scroll in the editor and set the maximum number of sticky lines to 5 in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: This task configures two VS Code sticky scroll settings: enabling the feature and setting the maximum number of sticky lines. The evaluator uses check_json_settings to verify both configurations are correctly set.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts VS Code settings.json from the standard Linux configuration path
Metric function check_json_settings properly verifies ALL instruction requirements (both editor.stickyScroll.enabled and editor.stickyScroll.maxLineCount)
Data flow is semantically correct: get_vm_file retrieves settings file, check_json_settings loads JSON and performs strict key-value matching
Expected values are accurate for the task requirements (enabled=true, maxLineCount=5)
Proper edge case handling: returns 0.0 for missing/malformed files, missing keys, or incorrect values
No postconfig needed as VS Code settings persist automatically after user changes
Complete instruction coverage: both sticky scroll settings are verified

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
